summary: BUG FIX VERIFIED. Tapping the 'Virtual' pill (testID='switch-virtual', label 'VIRTUAL', icon 'bicycle') in the Live Workout HUD now routes to /virtual-route via router.push('/virtual-route') as expected. The Virtual Route screen loads its cinematic 2.5D scene (rider silhouette on landscape road + connection pill 'Connected'), the setup card with rider selection ('Alpine Sunset Pass · Dolomites, Italy · 20 km', rider-male / rider-female / mature variants) renders, START RIDE begins the ride and the full telemetry panel (vr-full-panel: POWER, CADENCE, SPEED, HR, GRADIENT, DISTANCE, ELAPSED) appears without errors. Browser back navigation returns cleanly to /workout. All 3 requested flows pass.

issues: The 'Virtual' pill inside the RouteVideo overlay measures ~106×38 px — height is below the 44pt minimum touch target. Acceptable for landscape tablet with mouse/touch but should be enlarged (min-height 44) for phone/small-tablet parity with 'Routes' pill.

RouteVideo YouTube embed shows 'Video unavailable — This content isn't available' in the preview environment (YouTube geo/embed block). Not caused by this bug fix, but the graceful fallback to Virtual mode (onVideoError) does NOT auto-fire for YouTube's inline 'unavailable' state — only for hard load errors — so users may only see the fallback if they tap Virtual manually. Consider detecting YouTube's 'unavailable' postMessage and triggering the same virtual-mode fallback.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' — react-native-web upgrade required. Reference: repo-wide (theme shadows/glow used across /app/frontend/src/theme and workout/virtual-route styles).

Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — move pointerEvents='box-none' props into style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/workout.tsx:760, /app/frontend/app/workout.tsx:766 (inlineRoutes uses `style={[..., {pointerEvents:'box-none'}]}` OK) and /app/frontend/app/virtual-route.tsx:101, :115, :130 (SafeAreaView pointerEvents='box-none' prop).

PAGEERROR: 'play() failed because the user didn't interact with the document first.' and 'this.api.isExternalMethodAvailable is not a function' fired while YouTube iframe was mid-init on /workout and /virtual-route. Not blocking but noisy. Consider gating video play() on user gesture on web.

action_items: Optional: bump the 'Virtual' HUD pill min-height to 44pt for consistent touch targets across form factors.
Optional: detect YouTube 'Video unavailable' state and auto-switch to VirtualRoute (extend existing onVideoError path).
Cleanup: migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow and move pointerEvents from props to style (react-native-web upgrade compliance).
